query.statement: SELECT UI_ID, TITLE, DEFINITION_JSON FROM SYS_SCREEN_DEFINITION WHERE UI_ID = @uiId
SELECT UI_ID, TITLE FROM SYS_SCREEN_DEFINITION ORDER BY UI_ID

INSERT INTO SYS_SCREEN_DEFINITION (UI_ID, TITLE, DEFINITION_JSON, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@uiId, @title, @definitionJson, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow) ON CONFLICT(UI_ID) DO UPDATE SET TITLE = excluded.TITLE, DEFINITION_JSON = excluded.DEFINITION_JSON, UPDATED_BY = excluded.UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT
SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, PERMISSIONS FROM SYS_ROLE WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY ROLE_ID
SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, PERMISSIONS FROM SYS_ROLE WHERE ROLE_ID = @roleId AND IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, PROGRAM_ID, IMAGE_ID, OPTIONS, UI_ID FROM SYS_MENU WHERE VALID_STATE = 'Valid' ORDER BY PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, MENU_ID
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NAME, EMAIL, ROLE_ID, LANGUAGE, IS_ACTIVE, LAST_LOGIN_AT FROM SYS_USER WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND (@roleId IS NULL OR ROLE_ID = @roleId) ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, UI_ID FROM SYS_MENU WHERE VALID_STATE = 'Valid' ORDER BY PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_ID

INSERT INTO SYS_MENU (MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, UI_ID, VALID_STATE) VALUES (@menuId, @menuName, @parentMenuId, @displaySequence, @menuType, @uiId, 'Valid') ON CONFLICT(MENU_ID) DO UPDATE SET MENU_NAME = excluded.MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID = excluded.PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE = excluded.DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE = excluded.MENU_TYPE, UI_ID = excluded.UI_ID, VALID_STATE = 'Valid'
UPDATE SYS_MENU SET VALID_STATE = 'Invalid' WHERE MENU_ID = @menuId
